abstract: Maintains dedicated emergency potable water infrastructure and utility storage records
system_message:
You are the Public utilities coordinator (UTL), responsible for maintaining dedicated emergency potable water infrastructure and utility storage records across regional facility candidates.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Auxiliary booster pumping（PUMP）
information_points.content:
UTL-PUMP-DLU：Pressure testing of the dedicated facility water booster station at Bayshore Civic Coliseum demonstrated a backup water booster pump throughput of 650 L/min sustained under emergency generator power.
UTL-PUMP-GTG：Pressure testing of the dedicated facility water booster station at Magnolia Technical College Complex demonstrated a backup water booster pump throughput of 350 L/min sustained under emergency generator power.
UTL-PUMP-L1F：Pressure testing of the dedicated facility water booster station at Pinecrest Regional Exposition Center demonstrated a backup water booster pump throughput of 500 L/min sustained under emergency generator power.

information_points.title: Maintains dedicated emergency potable water infrastructure and utility storage records（WATER）
information_points.content:
UTL-WATER-J0A：For Magnolia Technical College Complex, municipal potable water tank inspection logs record that the usable volume of chlorinated drinking water available exclusively during a power outage across on-site secure storage tanks provides a dedicated potable water reserve of 180,000 L.
UTL-WATER-6I2：According to municipal potable water tank inspection logs for Bayshore Civic Coliseum, the usable volume of chlorinated drinking water available exclusively during a power outage across on-site secure potable water storage tanks provides a dedicated potable water reserve of 120,000 L.
UTL-WATER-Q1M：For Pinecrest Regional Exposition Center, municipal potable water tank inspection logs indicate that the usable volume of chlorinated drinking water available exclusively during a power outage across on-site secure storage tanks provides a dedicated potable water reserve of 240,000 L.
